data.MarkerNames:
Well formation/marker names and stratigraphy levels (with tops and lithology/stratigraphic units) reported in the excerpts:
- Egmont Volcanics (Pleistocene): 14–308 ft AHBKB; lithology: andesitic laharic/pyroclastic/alluvial volcanoclastics; fine–very coarse sand-sized lapilli tuff with minor scoria; basal 281–308 ft interbedded volcanoclastics and shelly marine sediments. Formation top also reported at ~305 ft TVD (daily drilling report) and at surface (m RKB, re-entry report).
- Rotokare/Whenuakura Subgroup (Late Pliocene): 308–3360 ft AHBKB. Formation top reported as Whenuakura at 299 m RKB; lithology: sandstone, siltstone.
- Tangahoe (Mid Pliocene): 3360–4326 ft AHBKB. Formation top reported at 3314 ft TVD (daily drilling report) / 3378 m RKB (re-entry report); lithology: muddy siltstone.
- Mateamateaonga (Late Miocene–Pliocene): 4326–6900 ft AHBKB. Formation top reported at 4288 ft TVD / 4344 m RKB; lithology: sandstone, siltstone.
- Wai-iti / Urenui (Late Miocene): 6900–7618 ft AHBKB. Formation top reported at 6873 ft TVD / 6918 m RKB; lithology: siltstone.
- Unknown Volcanic Succession (Mid Miocene?): Warea-1 7618–9518 ft AHBKB; Warea Deep-1 8400–11077 ft AHBKB. Re-entry report additionally lists 'Meta-sediments' at 7308 m RKB with lithology 'meta-sediments'.
Additional formation markers/tops listed in the daily drilling reports (no lithology given in excerpts): Mount Messenger (top 10098 ft TVD), Moki (top 11581 ft TVD), Kapuni (top 13386 ft TVD).
data.WellboreTrajectoryType: Warea-1 was drilled as a vertical hole (straight hole), though deviations up to 15° at 2232 ft were measured. Warea Deep-1 kicked off at the casing shoe (~2236–2240 ft) and drilled a new, deviated wellbore to TD.
data.WellboreStatus: The well status is "Temporarily abandoned" (as at 4 December 2001).
